title: GLP-1 is defining a beauty future built around systems, says Mintel
summary: With the increasing dominance of GLP-1 weight loss products, consumer insights firm Mintel has predicted a future where beauty consumers seek out systems and routines over individual product use in its Global Predictions 2027 report

extraction.key_fact: 민텔은 GLP-1 확산으로 소비자가 개별 제품보다 시스템과 루틴을 찾게 될 것으로 내다봤다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: consumer insights firm Mintel has predicted a future where beauty consumers seek out systems and routines over individual product use
